title: Quick Vault Search
shortDescription: Search your Bitwarden vault and copy a username, password or TOTP code without leaving the keyboard.
description:
Type "bitwarden", unlock with your master password, and search your logins by name, website or username. Copied secrets are kept out of clipboard history and cleared after a few seconds. The vault locks after inactivity and when Windows locks or sleeps.

Requires the official Bitwarden CLI (winget install Bitwarden.CLI), logged in once with bw login.
